import re

ROW = re.compile(r'^\s*(?P<fmt>[^\s*]+)(?P<star>\*)?\s+(?:(?P<module>\S+)\s+)?(?P<mode>[r-][w-][+-])(?:\s+(?P<desc>.*?))?\s*$')
HDR = re.compile(r'^\s*Format\s+Module\s+Mode\s+Description')
RULE = re.compile(r'^\s*-{5,}\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    skip = []
    used = []
    recs = []
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        if HDR.match(l) or RULE.match(l):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = ROW.match(l)
        if m:
            recs.append({'Format': m.group('fmt'), 'Native Blob': 'yes' if m.group('star') else 'no', 'Module': m.group('module') or '', 'Mode': m.group('mode'), 'Description': m.group('desc') or ''})
            used.append(i)
            continue
        if recs and l.startswith(' '):
            d = recs[-1]['Description']
            t = l.strip()
            recs[-1]['Description'] = (d + ' ' + t) if d else t
            used.append(i)
    return {'blocks': [{'name': 'formats', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': recs}], 'skip': skip}
